events.name: BAR_CLICK
events.description: Event emitted when a bar is clicked: UI:{barClickEvent} with { id }

events.name: GanttLoaded
events.description: Gantt rows finished loading; payload.data holds the collection.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bar Click Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted when a bar is clicked: UI:{barClickEvent} with { id }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Day Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Pixels per day on the axis (default 28)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Duration Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row field holding the task length in days, used when the row has no end.

overridableConfigKeys.label: End Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row field holding the end timestamp (ISO or epoch). Defaults to `end`. When absent, `durationField` (days) is used instead.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Group Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row field rows are grouped under header rows by. Empty (default) = flat list.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Range End
overridableConfigKeys.description: Last visible day (ISO or Date). Defaults to 2 days after the latest task end.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Range Start
overridableConfigKeys.description: First visible day (ISO or Date). Defaults to 2 days before the earliest task.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fetch its own rows on mount?
overridableConfigKeys.description: true (default) = standalone mount self-populates on INIT. false = a composing atom owns the fetch and routes its loaded event here — suppresses the wrapper's own un-hydrated fetch so it cannot race the composer's.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show Today
overridableConfigKeys.description: Paint the today marker line when today falls inside the range (default true).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Start Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row field holding the start timestamp (ISO or epoch). Defaults to `start`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Status Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row field holding the bar status (drives bar colour). Defaults to `status`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Title Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row field holding the bar label. Defaults to `title`.

capabilities: gantt chart, project timeline, schedule view, task bars, dependency arrows, roadmap, milestone plan
